sourceLicenses.acsB01001: United States federal government public-domain statistical data

geography: 119th Congress 435 voting House districts, excluding DC and nonvoting territories
populationUniverse: 2025 ACS estimated residents age 25+ in 435 districts, including noncitizens; not legally eligible candidate pool
memberUniverse: Voting House members in roster snapshot; vacant seats excluded from member denominator

uncertainty.ageBandSourceMOE90: Published district MOEs exist; no valid national aggregate/share MOE or confidence interval calculated
uncertainty.memberAgeSourceStatus: Secondary roster birth dates not independently primary-source-verified

limitations: 2025 ACS resident estimates compared with a 2026-10-30 member snapshot, not a synchronized point-in-time population
Population includes noncitizens and residents ineligible for House candidacy; legal eligibility not modeled
District estimates and member counts are different measurement universes; ratio is descriptive only
District age shares and party strata are not evidence of causal political responsiveness or misconduct
Member biographies and birth dates require independent primary-source confirmation
No survey microdata, occupational histories, disclosed-wealth intervals, or voter preferences used
No statistical tests: ACS design covariance and valid share standard errors not available in this aggregate
Party-stratified district residents exclude the two vacant districts; vacancy residual is reported explicitly and not assigned to any party.
The all-435-district resident comparison and occupied-433-district resident comparison use different denominators; neither is a voter-eligible or causal comparison.

unoccupiedDistrictPopulationDescriptive.scope: ACS 2025 residents in the two districts recorded vacant in 2026-10-30 member snapshot; aggregate residual across FL-20 and TX-23, not separately inferred district figures
unoccupiedDistrictPopulationDescriptive.derivation: all435DistrictsACS - sum(partyStrataDescriptive districtResidents) for both age denominators
unoccupiedDistrictPopulationDescriptive.partyAssignmentReason: No seated member in snapshot; previous incumbent party must not be imputed
unoccupiedDistrictPopulationDescriptive.uncertainty: Residual of published ACS point estimates; not an independently measured variance or MOE

occupiedDistrictPopulationDescriptive.comparisonUniverse: Only districts with a seated voting House member in 2026-10-30 roster; retains resident-versus-member eligibility and vintage caveats
